feature: MQTT QoS2 serial durable-session broker profile
head: 32302c4d6acec56044919a894cfa169218b813f9
command: perf record -F 999 -e cycles:Pu -g --call-graph dwarf -- taskset -c 1 netz-mqtt-vector-broker --bind=127.0.0.1:18832 --connections=2 --max-queued-deliveries=20000 --max-outgoing-inflight=64

profile.Waiter.waitTask / Executor.park: 55.9% children; the broker is mostly parked or waiting for I/O and timers

conclusion: Serial QoS2 latency is dominated by event-loop parking, wakeups, and clock reads rather than one large CPU hotspot. Further micro-optimizing route/flush helpers is unlikely to close the Mosquitto gap; a future change must reduce task wakeups or ownership boundaries, or improve the session/persistence scheduling path.
